```{python}
#| context: setup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from theme import ESPRIT, ESB_RED, INK, FONT

def dash(fig):
    """Layout dashboard : pas de hauteur forcée, la carte dimensionne."""
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_white",
        autosize=True,
        margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
        font=dict(family=FONT, size=12, color=INK),
        legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.18, x=0.5, xanchor="center"),
    )
    return fig

# Chargement données
enseignements = pd.read_csv("../data/enseignements.csv")
encadrements = pd.read_csv("../data/encadrements.csv")
certifications = pd.read_csv("../data/certifications.csv")
responsabilites = pd.read_csv("../data/responsabilites.csv")
evenements = pd.read_csv("../data/evenements.csv")

# Année de début
enseignements["annee_debut"] = enseignements["annee_universitaire"].str.split("-").str[0].astype(int)
certifications["annee_debut"] = pd.to_datetime(certifications["date"], errors="coerce").dt.year
encadrements["annee_debut"] = pd.to_numeric(encadrements["annee"], errors="coerce")
responsabilites["annee_debut"] = pd.to_datetime(responsabilites["debut"], errors="coerce").dt.year
evenements["annee_debut"] = pd.to_datetime(evenements["date"], errors="coerce").dt.year

# Table longue commune : une ligne par activité et par an
def par_an(df, categorie):
    out = df.dropna(subset=["annee_debut"]).groupby("annee_debut").size().reset_index(name="count")
    out["categorie"] = categorie
    return out

timeline = pd.concat([
    par_an(enseignements, "Enseignements (cours)"),
    par_an(encadrements, "Encadrements & jurys"),
    par_an(certifications, "Certifications"),
    par_an(evenements, "Événements"),
    par_an(responsabilites, "Responsabilités"),
], ignore_index=True)
timeline["annee_debut"] = timeline["annee_debut"].astype(int)
```

## Row {height="430px"}

### Column {width=60%}

```{python}
#| title: "Timeline globale — volume d'activités par année et par catégorie"
fig = px.area(
    timeline.sort_values("annee_debut"),
    x="annee_debut", y="count", color="categorie",
    labels={"annee_debut": "Année", "count": "Volume", "categorie": ""},
    color_discrete_sequence=ESPRIT,
)
dash(fig)
fig.show()
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{python}
#| title: "Heatmap année × type d'activité"
heatmap_df = (timeline.pivot_table(index="categorie", columns="annee_debut",
                                   values="count", aggfunc="sum")
              .fillna(0).astype(int))

fig = px.imshow(
    heatmap_df.values,
    x=heatmap_df.columns.astype(str),
    y=heatmap_df.index,
    color_continuous_scale=[[0, "#FFFFFF"], [0.3, "#FCE4EC"], [0.7, "#EF9A9A"], [1, ESB_RED]],
    text_auto=True,
    aspect="auto",
    labels={"x": "Année", "y": "", "color": "Volume"},
)
dash(fig)
fig.update_layout(coloraxis_showscale=False)
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="380px"}

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Volume total par catégorie"
totals = (timeline.groupby("categorie")["count"].sum()
          .sort_values().reset_index())

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=totals["count"], y=totals["categorie"], orientation="h",
    text=totals["count"], textposition="outside",
    marker=dict(color=ESB_RED),
))
fig.update_xaxes(range=[0, totals["count"].max() * 1.15])
dash(fig)
fig.show()
```

### Column {width=55%}

```{python}
#| title: "Cumul de toutes les activités au fil des années"
cumul = (timeline.groupby("annee_debut")["count"].sum()
         .sort_index().cumsum())

fig = go.Figure(go.Scatter(
    x=list(cumul.index), y=list(cumul.values),
    mode="lines+markers+text", text=list(cumul.values),
    textposition="top center", textfont=dict(size=10),
    line=dict(color=ESB_RED, width=3),
    marker=dict(size=7),
    fill="tozeroy", fillcolor="rgba(200,16,46,0.08)",
))
fig.update_yaxes(rangemode="tozero")
dash(fig)
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="620px"}

```{python}
#| title: "Chronologie des responsabilités (Gantt)"
gantt = responsabilites.copy()
gantt["debut_dt"] = pd.to_datetime(gantt["debut"], errors="coerce")
gantt["fin_dt"] = pd.to_datetime(gantt["fin"], errors="coerce").fillna(pd.Timestamp("2026-09-01"))
gantt = gantt.dropna(subset=["debut_dt"]).sort_values("debut_dt")

fig = px.timeline(
    gantt, x_start="debut_dt", x_end="fin_dt", y="responsabilite", color="type",
    color_discrete_sequence=ESPRIT,
    labels={"responsabilite": "", "type": ""},
    hover_data=["perimetre"],
)
fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", tickfont=dict(size=10))
dash(fig)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.06, x=0, xanchor="left"))
fig.show()
```
